task: Add a Project History Modal (isolated store, project-scoped API client, shared event-presentation module, and migration of the platform-admin Activity Events page onto it) to codemie-ui.

key_reasoning.reason: Six deliverables across layers: new project-scoped store (no in-repo precedent for a non-singleton Valtio store), new types module, new shared event-presentation module, new modal + filter subcomponents, entry-point edit on ProjectDetailsPage, and a migration of ActivityEventsPage.tsx's raw-JSON/chip rendering onto the shared module.

Contract and acceptance criteria are detailed and confirmed against the shipped backend, but two implementation decisions are explicitly open in the research: expand-in-row vs. popup-on-click for detail rendering, and the isolation mechanism (factory-produced proxy vs. component-local state) for the non-singleton store.

Closest pattern is the singleton ActivityEventsStore/Popup/Table stack, which covers filter chrome, pagination, and row expansion, but has no precedent for the required isolated-store mechanism; combined with the test-coverage gap on the exact code being changed (no test exists for the Popup detail view, the chip rendering being replaced, or the personal-project gate), and enumerated edge cases (unknown event type fallback, deleted-actor identity snapshot, empty vs. disabled state) with no existing defensive-test template to extend.

Estimated ~5-6 new files (store, types module, shared presentation module, modal, filter subcomponents) and ~2-3 modified files (ProjectDetailsPage.tsx, ActivityEventsPage.tsx, possibly activityEventsFilters.ts) across 3+ directories (store/, types/entity/, pages/settings/administration/ and its components/ subtree).

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L (4) to XL (5): 'Migrate/Refactor' — the task requires migrating ActivityEventsPage.tsx's existing raw-JSON Popup detail view and raw-chip row rendering onto the new shared presentation module, a refactor of an existing subsystem rather than purely additive work.

Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): acceptance criteria enumerate specific edge/error cases (unknown event type fallback, deleted-actor identity snapshot, empty-vs-disabled state distinction, error/retry state) and no existing test template in this codebase covers this defensive pattern for activity events — ActivityEventsPage.test.tsx only covers pure filter-helper functions, not the Popup/chip rendering or these edge cases.
